shortDescription: Its main function is the ability to remove (or "prune") nodes that have been disabled since a specific date on BIG-IP.

options.name: before_date
options.description: This is a specific date provided as an input to the module. The main function of the module will use this date as a reference point to remove all nodes that have been disabled before this date. The date should be provided in the YYYY/MM/DD format.
